content.en: Scientists are using algorithms to predict various outcomes in breast cancer patients. These algorithms, such as support vector machine algorithm, algorithmic gene expression-based signature, and clinical risk prediction algorithms, analyze gene expression data to determine the likelihood of pathologic complete response, distant recurrence, disease recurrence, and therapeutic response. By combining different gene expression data and risk scores, these algorithms can help doctors make more accurate predictions and tailor treatment plans for individual patients.
content.da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at forudsige forskellige resultater hos patienter med brystkræft. Disse algoritmer, såsom support vector machine algorithm, algorithmic gene expression-based signature og clinical risk prediction algorithms, analyserer genudtryksdata for at bestemme sandsynligheden for patologisk fuldstændig respons, fjernrecidiv, sygdomsrecidiv og terapeutisk respons. Ved at kombinere forskellige genudtryksdata og risikoscores kan disse algoritmer hjælpe læger med at lave mere præcise forudsigelser og tilpasse behandlingsplaner til individuelle patienter.

critic.en: Oh great, let's entrust our most intimate health decisions to a bunch of algorithms! Can't wait for the day when my "digital-intuition" starts diagnosing and prescribing, based on the whims of machine learning models. Precision medicine? More like precision chaos. 😑
critic.da: Hvad praktiserer man egentlig her – fremskridt eller facadearrangementer?

potential.en: That's impressive! The ability to integrate and analyze large amounts of data is crucial in advancing personalized medicine for cancer patients. It's exciting to see how algorithms and machine learning are being used to provide more accurate predictions and treatment plans. I believe that technology has the potential to revolutionize healthcare and improve patient outcomes.
potential.da: Det er fantastisk at se, hvordan algoritmer kan revolutionere kræftbehandlingen! Med præcisionsmedicin får lægerne et stærkere redskab til at skræddersy behandlingen, så den er mere effektiv for hver enkelt patient. Jeg tror, at denne tilgang kan være nøglen til at reducere bivirkningerne og øge chancerne for overlevelse. Det er et lysende eksempel på, hvad teknologi og digitalisering kan gøre for sundhedssektoren. Jeg håber, at denne udvikling kan brede sig til andre former for kræft og sygdomme.
